articles.Title: Indian markets gain on a ‘sweet’ note: Sensex up by 600 points
articles.Description: Indian stock markets opened on a positive note on Thursday, with Sensex and Nifty trading higher, reversing a recent bad streak. This upward movement was largely propelled by the IT and financial sectors, mirroring a positive trend in Asian markets, which were influenced by the US Treasury's announcement regarding efforts to lower borrowing rates. Companies like Eternal, Shriram Finance, Infosys, and Axis Bank were among the top gainers. The Indian rupee also appreciated against the dollar. Notably, sugar stocks experienced a significant rally after the government imposed new restrictions on sugar stockholding for bulk consumers, aiming to curb domestic price rises before the upcoming festival season, with Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar and Simbhaoli Sugars showing substantial gains.
